6.259 rsInvalidInnerDataSetName
rsInvalidInnerDataSetName is a critical error that occurs when a data region has a different
DataSetName property than a child data region. For example, this error will occur if a Tablix has a
Tablix.DataSetName element whose value is different from the value of a Chart.DataSetName element
of a contained Chart.
